tools.name: json_to_toon
tools.description: Convert JSON to TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation), a compact format that uses about 43% fewer LLM tokens than JSON on average. Best for uniform arrays of objects.

tools.name: toon_to_json
tools.description: Decode a TOON document back to pretty-printed JSON.
